name: vra_iaas-mcp
description: The official MCP Server for the Vra Iaas API

VRA_FQDN.title: vra_fqdn
VRA_FQDN.description: FQDN of your vRA / VCF Automation appliance (for example: vra.example.local)

VRA_USERNAME.title: vra_username
VRA_USERNAME.description: Username for vRA login (vRA 8.x, or VCFA 9.x session login; leave empty when using an API token)

VRA_PASSWORD.title: vra_password
VRA_PASSWORD.description: Password for vRA login (vRA 8.x, or VCFA 9.x session login; leave empty when using an API token)

VRA_ORG.title: vra_org
VRA_ORG.description: VCFA 9.x tenant organization name (leave empty for vRA 8.x)

VRA_ORG_TYPE.title: vra_org_type
VRA_ORG_TYPE.description: VCFA 9.x organization type: vm-apps, all-apps or provider

VRA_API_TOKEN.title: vra_api_token
VRA_API_TOKEN.description: VCFA 9.x API token (My Account > API Tokens). Recommended for 9.x
